findings.issue: resources() retains taskQuery but drops the reader fallbackReason, fallback BSD query and esrchRecheck evidence; its bsdQuery still denotes the outer before-read.
findings.impact: DarwinActivity.read already performs one immediate re-read for ESRCH with valid live fallback BSD. The historical stopping receipt cannot determine whether that branch ran or which final fallback identity/state was observed.
findings.requiredNextChange: Preserve bounded safe read/fallback/recheck traces with explicit before/read/after operation labels; reset per-candidate fields and keep totals null on failure.

proposedRecovery.assessment: A narrow bounded same-candidate revalidation can be reviewed safely; no implementation or Mac effectiveness is approved by this design assessment.
proposedRecovery.eligibleTrigger: Only final task bytes0/expected232/errnoESRCH, with a fresh fully validated live BSD matching the original PID/birth/UID/RUID identity.
proposedRecovery.success: At most one additional documented read attempt, preserving the original identity anchor; accept full same-birth task counters only after matching full BSD identity. Add RSS/CPU once.
proposedRecovery.gone: Only authoritative same-identity full BSD zombie or independent kill0 ESRCH; never role, missing counters or generation replacement. Self disappearance is never accepted.
proposedRecovery.unknown: Any permission, malformed/short BSD, changed birth/credentials/state, persistent missing task or unsupported error remains unknown/null and fail-closed.
proposedRecovery.bounds: Account explicitly for existing reader internal re-read when declaring the maximum task-query count; retain phase/stall/resource limits and query/resource target scope.
negativeTests: Recovered same-identity measurement with no RSS double counting and retained first/retry trace.
Same-PID different-generation live and zombie, or same-birth credential change, stay unknown.
EPERM/EACCES and non-ESRCH short/invalid counters do not gain general retries.
Persistent ESRCH and fresh-BSD unavailability exhaust a fixed call budget and preserve null totals/first failure.
Authoritative same-birth zombie and independent ESRCH may be confirmed gone; generation-replaced and self-gone may not.
A complete final zero primary-census delta remains mandatory even after candidate-resource recovery.
Safe fixed operation/query/reason metadata survives; raw PID/path/argv/exception text and stale previous-candidate fields do not.
proposedRecovery.remainingGate: Immutable patch review, focused negative tests and representative actual-Mac candidate lifecycle/API revalidation are still required before retrying the long path.
